name: ernestdefoe/panels
description: Panels: a manga, webtoon and comics library and reader for Flarum 2. Series with image chapters or .cbz uploads, a phone-first reader (vertical webtoon, page, right-to-left manga), reading progress, libraries and follows, a discussion for every chapter, age gating and a copyright takedown flow.

suggest.flarum/tags: Chapter discussions in a tag of your choice
suggest.flarum/gdpr: Libraries, places and ratings in a member's data export and erasure
suggest.ernestdefoe/kiosk: Sell series and chapters, with early access
suggest.ernestdefoe/renown: XP for publishing and finishing chapters
suggest.ernestdefoe/spoiler-shield: Chapter talk blurred past each member's place
